messages:
pagerduty-bot: ALERT: gpu-pool-usw2 saturated (90% queue growth). HPA scaling delayed — custom metrics ingestion > 5m lag. Pager: oncall-eng (sophia).

sophia: acked. I'm on it, pinging infra and metrics. Can someone grab the prometheus/adaptor dashboards?

nate: looking. prometheus scrape lag spiking from ~30s -> ~6m since 09:12 UTC. adapter queue backlog: 12k. metrics-server reporting 503s on scrape.

metrics-bot: Prometheus alert -> prometheus_scrape_duration_seconds{job="prometheus"} spike. last 5m: 340s p50, 620s p95.

alex: sounds like the custom metrics path is the choke. HPA is starving because metrics-adapter isn't delivering. That explains GPU queue growth — pods not autoscaling.

lee: initial triage: metrics-adapter pods are OOM'ing on one replica set. logs show repeated k8s API timeout and then crash loops. grabbing logs now.

lee: logs snippet:
```
I0409 09:15:22.123] error: failed to read metrics: context deadline exceeded
I0409 09:15:22.124] panic: runtime: out of memory
...stack trace...
```

sophia: mitigation plan (short): 1) manual scale GPU-serving Deployment up to +20% to buy time, 2) increase HPA target to avoid immediate throttle, 3) restart metrics-adapter and bump memory, 4) split prometheus scrape load to reduce pressure. I'll execute 1 and 3 now.

alex: add a temporary fallback rule to route low-priority queued requests to cpu-backend. reduces GPU demand. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-pressure

maria: pinging CS — visible errors for some customers using high-throughput batch endpoints. Preparing customer impact note.

sophia: scaling GPU pool (manual)
```bash
# increase replica count for gpu-serving to 48 (was 40)
kubectl scale --namespace inference deployment/gpu-serving --replicas=48
# allow immediate scheduling by cordoning/rescheduling non-critical nodes if needed
```

lee: restarting metrics-adapter with bumped memory
```bash
kubectl set resources deployment/metrics-adapter -n kube-system --limits=memory=1Gi --requests=memory=512Mi
kubectl rollout restart deployment/metrics-adapter -n kube-system
```

nate: also temporarily increasing HPA min replicas to prevent under-scaling: `kubectl patch hpa gpu-serving -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 20}}'`

metrics-bot: metrics-adapter pods restarted at 09:23 UTC, initial readiness failing but logs show decreased OOMs. adapter queue dropped from 12k -> 3.6k in 5m.

lee: rolling restart of prometheus sidecars to relieve long-lived connections. Doing canary first on prometheus-1.

alex: routing change applied to low-priority workload (cpu-fallback) via feature-flag `fallback-gpu-to-cpu=true` for batch route. Should throttle less on GPU.

maria: customer impact note v1 ready: "Some high-throughput batch jobs may see increased latency or failures between 09:10-09:30 UTC. We're applying mitigations and will update. Ticket #INC-3421." Posting to status page.

incident-bot: Incident declared: sev2. Channel created: #inc-3421-gpu-autoscale. Incident ticket: https://redwood.incidents/INC-3421

sophia: handoff plan: I'll stay until stabilization confirmed (< 5% queue growth sustained for 15m, adapter queue < 200). Diego, can you take the night handoff at 10:30 UTC if stable?

diego: I can take it. please leave a concise summary and action items.

sophia: summary for handoff:
- root cause: metrics-adapter memory pressure + Prometheus scrape lag -> custom metrics pipeline delay -> HPA under-reacting -> GPU pod queue growth -> throttling
- mitigations applied: manual scale GPU-serving +20%; HPA minReplicas forced to 20; metrics-adapter memory bumped and restarted; prometheus sidecars restarted; low-priority traffic routed to cpu fallback; status page and CS notified.
- next steps for diego: monitor adapter queue and `kube_hpa_status`; if adapter backlog > 3k for >10m, escalate to eng-infra and consider rolling-prometheus-cluster restart. Check node scheduling pressure and GPU scheduler logs for preemption.

lee: follow-up: we need a postmortem on why adapter memory regressed — opening a ticket in eng-ml to audit recent changes to metrics encoding and retention.

maria: CS update posted. Will email top-10 affected customers with mitigation summary and ETA for full resolution.

nate: metrics now: adapter queue 800 -> trending down, gpu-serving queue steady, overall latency improving.

metrics-bot: Prometheus scrape lag back to baseline ~20s.

incident-bot: Handoff performed at 10:31 UTC to diego. Oncall rotation updated.

sophia: leaving handoff notes in #inc-3421-gpu-autoscale and adding runbook steps + commands used. Will open follow-up action items: increase adapter memory margins, add better OOM alert, and autoscaler fallback rule for sustained metrics lag.

diego: thanks — taking over. Will follow the checklist and keep #inc-3421 pinned.

maria: closing customer comms loop after 11:00 UTC.

pagerduty-bot: Alert cleared at 10:45 UTC (metrics stabilized).

sophia: closing oncall thread — team, please add root cause details to the postmortem and include a timeline. Good job coordinating. :thumbsup:
